description.value: Echo Landing is a collection of contemporary ski-in, ski-out townhomes and condos located in the quieter east village of Sun Peaks Resort, BC's second-largest four-season mountain resort. Units range from 2 to 4 bedrooms and include full kitchens, with select units offering private hot tubs. The property sits adjacent to the Orient chairlift and Sun Peaks' extensive bike park and trail network, making it a convenient base for mountain biking in summer.
